in_marathi.name: Satyanarayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Truth and Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyanarayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyanarayan is a popular Hindu deity and an avatar of Lord Vishnu. The name Satyanarayan is derived from Sanskrit words 'Satyam' meaning 'truth' and 'Narayan' meaning 'protector'. The name is a symbol of honesty, truthfulness, and protection.
